Method Route SDK operation Returns

PUT /api/v1/payruns/{id} update The updated Payrun record
PUT /api/v1/payruns/{id}/cancel update No result is returned
PUT /api/v1/payruns/{id}/reject update The updated Payrun record
PUT /api/v1/payruns/{id}/unarchive update No result is returned

Parameters

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | id | path | string (uuid) | Yes | The payrun id |

application/json

Property Type Required Description

notes string No

Responses

200: OK

Authentication: API key in the header (Bearer).

Parameters

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | id | path | string (uuid) | Yes | The payrun id |

application/json

Property Type Required Description
scheduledDate string (date-time) No

200: OK
202: Accepted

payouts[].topupPayrunID string (uuid) No The ID of a payrun that needs an account top up. Payouts can be used to top up payrun accounts.
payouts[].transactedAmount number (double) No The actual amount debited from the account in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Currency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null for non-FX payouts and payouts with no settled transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxAmount number (double) No The actual amount received by the beneficiary in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationCurrency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxRate number (double) No The actual FX rate applied during settlement, as recorded on the associated transaction. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.

payouts[].transactedAmount number (double) No The actual amount debited from the account in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Currency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null for non-FX payouts and payouts with no settled transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxAmount number (double) No The actual amount received by the beneficiary in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationCurrency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxRate number (double) No The actual FX rate applied during settlement, as recorded on the associated transaction. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.

When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null for non-FX payouts and payouts with no settled transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxAmount number (double) No The actual amount received by the beneficiary in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationCurrency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxRate number (double) No The actual FX rate applied during settlement, as recorded on the associated transaction. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.

list

GET /api/v1/payruns

Operation ID: GetPayrunsPaged.

Authentication: API key in the header (Bearer).

Parameters

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | merchantID | query | string (uuid) | No | The merchant ID to get the payruns for | | pageNumber | query | integer (int32) | No | The page number from where records are retrieved. | | pageSize | query | integer (int32) | No | The number of records to be retrieved from a page. | | fromDate | query | string (date-time) | No | The date filter to apply to retrieve payruns created after this date. | | toDate | query | string (date-time) | No | The date filter to apply to retrieve payruns created up until this date. | | sort | query | string | No | Optional expression to sort the order of the payruns. | | statuses | query | array of enum: None, Draft, Submitted, Completed, Rejected, AuthorisationPending, ... | No | An optional status filter list | | search | query | string | No | The text filter to apply to retrieve payruns | | onlyArchived | query | boolean | No | Flag that indicates whether to fetch only archived payruns or not |

Responses

200: OK

content[].payouts[].transactedAmount number (double) No The actual amount debited from the account in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Currency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null for non-FX payouts and payouts with no settled transaction.
content[].payouts[].transactedFxAmount number (double) No The actual amount received by the beneficiary in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationCurrency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
content[].payouts[].transactedFxRate number (double) No The actual FX rate applied during settlement, as recorded on the associated transaction. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.

payouts[].transactedAmount number (double) No The actual amount debited from the account in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Currency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null for non-FX payouts and payouts with no settled transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxAmount number (double) No The actual amount received by the beneficiary in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationCurrency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxRate number (double) No The actual FX rate applied during settlement, as recorded on the associated transaction. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.

payouts[].transactedAmount number (double) No The actual amount debited from the account in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Currency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null for non-FX payouts and payouts with no settled transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxAmount number (double) No The actual amount received by the beneficiary in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationCurrency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxRate number (double) No The actual FX rate applied during settlement, as recorded on the associated transaction. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.

payouts[].transactedAmount number (double) No The actual amount debited from the account in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Currency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null for non-FX payouts and payouts with no settled transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxAmount number (double) No The actual amount received by the beneficiary in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationCurrency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxRate number (double) No The actual FX rate applied during settlement, as recorded on the associated transaction. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.

payouts[].transactedAmount number (double) No The actual amount debited from the account in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Currency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null for non-FX payouts and payouts with no settled transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxAmount number (double) No The actual amount received by the beneficiary in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationCurrency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxRate number (double) No The actual FX rate applied during settlement, as recorded on the associated transaction. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.

payouts[].transactedAmount number (double) No The actual amount debited from the account in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Currency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null for non-FX payouts and payouts with no settled transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxAmount number (double) No The actual amount received by the beneficiary in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationCurrency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxRate number (double) No The actual FX rate applied during settlement, as recorded on the associated transaction. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.

200: No result is returned

payouts[].transactedAmount number (double) No The actual amount debited from the account in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Currency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null for non-FX payouts and payouts with no settled transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxAmount number (double) No The actual amount received by the beneficiary in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationCurrency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxRate number (double) No The actual FX rate applied during settlement, as recorded on the associated transaction. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.

payouts[].transactedAmount number (double) No The actual amount debited from the account in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Currency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null for non-FX payouts and payouts with no settled transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxAmount number (double) No The actual amount received by the beneficiary in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationCurrency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxRate number (double) No The actual FX rate applied during settlement, as recorded on the associated transaction. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.

payouts[].transactedAmount number (double) No The actual amount debited from the account in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Currency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed at creation, so this should closely match NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is true the beneficiary's received amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.Amount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null for non-FX payouts and payouts with no settled transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxAmount number (double) No The actual amount received by the beneficiary in NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationCurrency, as recorded on the settled transaction. When NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxUseDestinationAmount is false the debit amount was fixed, so this may differ from the estimated NoFrixion.MoneyMoov.Models.Payout.FxDestinationAmount due to rate movement between quote and settlement. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
payouts[].transactedFxRate number (double) No The actual FX rate applied during settlement, as recorded on the associated transaction. Null if the payout has no settled FX transaction.
